title: Pinout connector definition
description: The JSON object produced by evaluating a connector Jsonnet file.
$comment: Pin numbers must be unique within a connector and must not exceed dimensions.width * dimensions.height. These constraints are checked by the program because standard JSON Schema cannot express them for arbitrary dimensions.

name.description: Connector name printed as the pinout header.

width.description: Number of pin columns. Two-column connectors place odd pins on the left and even pins on the right.

height.description: Number of pin rows. Each connector has width * height pins, numbered from 1.

pins.description: Optional pin definitions, matched by number regardless of array order. Pins without a definition are printed without a label.

number.description: Pin number starting at 1 within this connector, unique within the pins array.

name.description: Fixed pin label. For GPIO pins it is printed only when gpiod_label matches an existing GPIO line.

color.description: Console foreground color for the pin label and number as #RRGGBB.

gpiod_label.description: Exact GPIO line name required for this pin to have a label. A matching pin uses name when defined, otherwise this value; an unmatched pin has no label.
